allot.subject: Corrigendum
allot.text: The Corrigendum is being issued on the behest of stock exchanges with respect to the In-Principle Application made for preferential issue. This is with reference to the Notice dated dated August 31, 2026, convening 32nd  Annual General Meeting (AGM) of shareholders of Orchasp Limited to be held on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 at 10.30 A.M at Plot No-19 & 20, Moti Valley, Trimulgherry, Secunderabad 500 015 through Video Conferencing ( VC ) / Other Audio-Visual Means ( OAVM ) to transact the business as set out in the Notice of AGM which has already been circulated to the shareholders.
